label: Scoring recommended rules
subgoals: Count the locations that meet the recommended value
Weight locations by yield impact where the score requires it

label: Wire spreading and critical area
subgoals: Write the critical area as proportional to one over the spacing
Take the ratio of the old to the new spacing
Subtract from one to get the reduction

label: How tools use recommended rules
subgoals: Apply recommended rules where routing resources are free
Insert redundant vias after detailed routing
Trade each rule's yield benefit against its area cost
